newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London fall in thin holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London fall in thin holiday trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London dropped on Monday, extending Friday's sharp falls, in thin volume following a market and public holiday in Hong Kong, dealers said.
The Hong Kong London Reference Index fell 236.54 points to close at 15,334.95 as concerns over the Hong Kong dollar combined with an early fall in London weighed on shares.
Dealers said turnover was minimal as only two market-makers opened quotes on the London Stock Exchange's SEAQ International system due to the holiday.
Shares in banking group HSBC Holdings tracked the weakness in British bank stocks and slid HK$4.85 fom their London close on Friday to finish at HK$254.35.
